collectorWelcome.subject: You're on the Collector List
collectorWelcome.preheader: Welcome, and thank you for joining my Collector Circle.
collectorWelcome.title: Welcome to the Collector Circle
collectorWelcome.body:
Welcome, and thank you for joining my Collector Circle. I'm so happy to have you!

This is where I'll share new work, first looks at upcoming paintings, and notes from the studio along the way. You'll be the first to hear about new collections, available pieces, and the ongoing process behind my journey.

I'm so glad you're here, and I look forward to sharing my work with you!
